modelEvidence: Accepted review-task configuration; no model self-identification used.

clauses.observation: Both exact excerpts contain the backslash-double-quote escape (\"), not a bare quote.
Both versions require exactly four hexadecimal digits; mixed-case positive and incomplete/non-hex negative cases match that rule.

Both versions require two UTF-16 surrogate codes for characters from U+10000. The planned negative is limited to malformed escapes and explicitly avoids inventing a separate unapproved scalar-validity restriction. The phrase 'literal representation' must mean the host-side expected decoded text, not approval of a raw non-ASCII INTERLIS source literal.
The consecutive-exclamation requirement and single/separated-mark countercases are version-neutral and supported in 2.3 and 2.4.
Both texts say the line ending terminates the comment; LF/CRLF visibility and source-position checks are appropriate implementation-profile cases.

Both exact excerpts identify slash-star as the opener. The adjacent sentence supports the planned unterminated-comment negative; a future complete inventory should still atomize block termination separately.
Both versions permit further characters in comments; preservation plus a following independent invalid-identifier range is a suitable positive/model countercheck.

findings.title: Raw XML verifier accepts a testcase from the wrong class when the method name matches
findings.evidence: check_raw_assertion_evidence derives only method+'()' and filters testcase elements only by the name attribute. An independently generated XML with testsuite name Other and testcase classname Other but name sample() was returned as PARTIAL_TESTCASE_PASSED for candidateTest Example.sample.
findings.impact: A changed evidence entry could bind a source method to a passing method of the same name in another test class, so --require-run-evidence does not fully prove the claimed testcase identity. The five current frozen mappings were separately inspected and do point to the correct classes; this is a verifier failure-path gap, not evidence that those five XMLs are false.
findings.requiredRework: Validate testcase@classname and preferably testsuite@name (or the canonical XML filename) against the candidate class, then add a wrong-class/same-method negative test. Preserve the current missing, changed, failing, skipped and wrong-method checks.
